# Genosphere

> Genosphere is an open-source interactive Tree of Life explorer and adaptive evolution tutor for teachers, students, researchers, naturalists, and curious people.

Canonical URL: https://genosphere.vercel.app
Source code: https://github.com/yakshb/tree-of-life
License: MIT

## What works today

- A searchable, pannable, zoomable, and progressively expandable Tree of Life with 124 curated nodes.
- Standardized biological summaries, taxonomic ranks, geological ranges, and living or extinct status.
- A resizable node inspector with node-grounded Groq chat and suggested questions.
- GBIF name reconciliation, accepted taxonomy, lineage, direct descendants, common names, media, and provenance.
- Independent iNaturalist matching for attributed taxon imagery and common names.

## Use cases and maturity

- Adaptive evolution tutor — available now. Explore lineages, compare traits, explain adaptations, and generate guided questions.
- Biodiversity field guide — near-term extension. Taxonomy, licensed media, common names, and descendant context exist now; observation and location overlays are planned.
- Taxonomic curation workbench — medium-term direction. Normalization, source reconciliation, warnings, and missing-data audits exist now; synonym, rank-conflict, and topology-drift review queues are planned.
- Paleobiology timeline — medium-term direction. Geological ranges and extinction status exist now; time filters and extinction-event overlays are planned.

## Important limitations

- Genosphere is an exploratory educational map, not a comprehensive or publication-ready phylogenetic authority.
- AI responses may be inaccurate. Verify scientific claims against primary literature and authoritative datasets.
- The curated teaching topology and live taxonomic sources serve different purposes; reconciliation does not silently overwrite topology.
- Media appears only when a source match and attribution are available.

## Public application endpoints

- GET /api/models — reports the Groq model catalog and configured model availability.
- GET /api/taxa — returns live taxonomic reconciliation and enrichment for a requested taxon.
- POST /api/chat — streams a node-grounded answer using an allowed Groq model.
- POST /api/generate-prompts — generates contextual questions using Llama 3.1 8B Instant.
